name: Himezono Yuka
source:
She is the step mother of Takeshi and the leader of the "8 Maman" candidates.

She is usually mild-mannered and rarely gets angry. However, people have two sides to them. Yuka is no exception.

The search for Maman came as a surprise to Takeshi. For Yuka and the other mamans, it was a major project that they had been working on for many years.

What was Yuka's experience as the step mother of Takeshi? And were her feelings for Takeshi only as a step mother? What is the true meaning of "Searching for Maman"?

Mystery after mystery, Takeshi himself begins to harbor doubts about Yuka.

[From [url=http://ps-web.net/tryset/maman/photo/yuka.html]official site[/url]]
